title: review outcome
description: The verifier's verdict on a review round (review-verify.md), its final message. The loop writes the change document's review_status from it: pending when must + should > 0, else addressed (F-68 D3).

must.description: The unchecked Must fix items in the session block this round wrote.

should.description: The unchecked Should fix items in the session block this round wrote.

nits.description: The unchecked Nits in the session block this round wrote.

escalated.description: true when the verifier wrote ## Escalation in the unit file.
